# How many tiles does this room really need?

> Free tile layout optimizer for tilers, flooring installers and DIYers. Enter the room, any cut-outs and tile sizes; it searches the grid start, tile direction and brick bond, reuses offcuts, and shows the fewest tiles and boxes to buy, a to-scale layout and a cutting list. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
